meta.title: OpenAEC Docs — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: OpenAEC Docs: a prototype document management system for BIM projects on Nextcloud, with fixed project folders, project manifests and sign-in through OIDC. Development has been on hold since April 2026.

header.label: Document management · prototype
header.title: OpenAEC Docs
header.tagline: The documents of BIM projects in one place
header.desc: A prototype document management system for BIM projects: a Rust server and a React web interface on top of Nextcloud. Fixed folders per project, a manifest of the models and issue sets that belong to it, and sign-in through OIDC. Development has been on hold since April 2026.

alt.empty: OpenAEC Docs without projects, prompting you to create a project or link a Nextcloud project folder

notice.text: Prototype on hold. No work has been done on OpenAEC Docs since April 2026. There are no releases, no hosted version and no installation guide; the source code is public on GitHub, without a licence yet.

features.label: Features
features.heading: What the prototype can do
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

files.title: Project files straight in Nextcloud
files.desc: Upload, open and delete files and create folders, per project. The files live in a project folder on Nextcloud; the server talks to it over WebDAV and keeps the metadata in PostgreSQL.

folders.title: Fixed project folders
folders.desc: A fixed layout per project, such as models, drawings, calculations and reports, with the allowed file types per folder. You can link an existing Nextcloud project folder instead of creating a new one.

manifest.title: What belongs to a project
manifest.desc: A project can have several manifests that record which IFC models, issue sets and reports belong to it, so other OpenAEC tools can find them. The project view shows them in a side panel.

connect.title: Sign-in, organisations and integrations
connect.desc: Sign in through single sign-on (OIDC), with several organisations on one installation, each with its own Nextcloud. Integrations with the OpenAEC BIM Validator and BCF platform, and everything through a REST API.

status.q: Is OpenAEC Docs still being developed?
status.a: No, not at the moment. The last change dates from April 2026 and the app is no longer listed on the homepage. For project files in the cloud, OpenAEC is now working on the SuperCloud.

try.a: There is no hosted version and no release. If you want to try it, you can build the source code from GitHub yourself and run it with Docker Compose; you then also need a Nextcloud, a PostgreSQL database and an OIDC provider.

what.q: What is a document management system for BIM projects?
what.a: One place that holds all the documents of a project, from models and drawings to calculations and reports, with a fixed folder layout and agreements on what goes where. OpenAEC Docs adds a manifest to that, so other tools also know which models and issue sets belong to a project.

nextcloud.a: Nextcloud is open source and can be self-hosted, so the files stay on a server you choose yourself. OpenAEC Docs keeps the files themselves in Nextcloud and only the administration in its own database.

relation.q: How does it relate to the SuperCloud?
relation.a: They are separate projects. OpenAEC Docs built on Nextcloud and the openaec-cloud library; the SuperCloud has its own storage server with spaces, versions and a desktop app for syncing.

licence.q: What licence is the code under?
licence.a: The source code is public on GitHub, but it does not carry a licence yet. If you want to use it, get in touch at info@open-aec.com.
